name: Coal India Ltd
description: Coal India Ltd (CIL) is a Maharatna PSU and the single largest coal producing corporation in the world, contributing over 80% of India's total domestic coal output. Operating across 83 mining areas in eight Indian states, Coal India is the primary guarantor of India's baseload energy security, feeding over 70% of the country's electricity generation.

company_profile.summary: Coal India Ltd (CIL) is a Maharatna PSU and the single largest coal producing corporation in the world, contributing over 80% of India's total domestic coal output. Operating across 83 mining areas in eight Indian states, Coal India is the primary guarantor of India's baseload energy security, feeding over 70% of the country's electricity generation.

revenue_breakup.segment: Fuel Supply Agreements (FSA) to Power Utilities
revenue_breakup.desc: Regulated long-term coal supply to state and central thermal power generation utilities.
Market-priced coal auctioned to non-power industrial consumers (cement, sponge iron, captive plants).
Beneficiated low-ash coking coal, middlings, and tar products.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% across nationwide thermal power plants and industrial clusters
moats_and_strengths: Near-monopoly producer supplying 80%+ of India's coal with insurmountable geographic mineral reserves.
Extraordinary cash generation resulting in industry-leading dividend yields (typically 6%–9%).
Extensive dedicated railway evacuation infrastructure (First Mile Connectivity) slashing logistical bottleneck costs.
Zero net debt balance sheet with high cash reserves exceeding ₹18,000 Cr.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Annual Coal Output: 770+ Million Tonnes (Targeting 1 Billion Tonnes) • 318 Operating Mines

bullish_triggers: India's thermal power peak generation reaching historic highs requiring record domestic coal dispatches.
Higher realization premiums on non-power e-auction coal volumes boosting operating EBITDA.
Mechanized First Mile Connectivity (FMC) projects reducing road haulage and siding loading costs.
bearish_risks: Government regulations limiting FSA price hikes to protect state electricity discoms from power inflation.
Periodic wage hike agreements for non-executive workforce impacting annual employee benefit expenses.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
